original_goal:
[Module: Reset App State | TC-003 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Unauthenticated user cannot perform Reset App State

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/reset-app-state
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{}

Preconditions:
  User is not authenticated (not logged in). If the test environment is currently logged in, tester must sign out first (use the application menu -> Logout) before performing the steps.

Steps to Execute:
  1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/reset-app-state
  2. Click the 'Reset App State' menu item

Expected Result:
  Action is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page (or shown an authentication prompt); Reset App State is not performed; cart contents, cart badge, and button states remain unchanged.

Notes from prior verification:
  Verification run showed the UI elements exist but the verification environment indicated a logged-in user, so the negative precondition (unauthenticated) could not be validated in that run. The preconditions were updated to instruct the tester to explicitly sign out if the environment is already authenticated.
expected_outcome: Action is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page (or shown an authentication prompt); Reset App State is not performed; cart contents, cart badge, and button states remain unchanged.
